}

arguments.summary: A privilege escalation incident was detected on endpoint 10.0.7.33, originating from 10.0.5.14 (WS-FIN-042). The attacker exploited a PrintNightmare variant (CVE-2025-31337) and performed post-exploitation activities including Golden Ticket creation via krbtgt hash theft. Lateral movement was observed via SMB, and Cobalt Strike beaconing was confirmed. Containment actions were attempted but denied due to policy restrictions. Critical identity infrastructure remains at risk.
